review_notes: Reviewed only the 16 true cursor additions in discovery-candidates.json; the 70-item carry-forward queue and the full 111-source registry were not re-reviewed.

Fifteen URLs had already appeared in earlier discovery runs. Legora was already merged into the September 3 GPT-6 Astra event; the Playco case is the same Astra deployment cluster and adds no new control or release boundary.
The one first-seen URL, OpenAI Academy for News Organizations, is an official page dated December 17, 2025, so its sitemap lastmod is not a new publication event.

The September 7 Ukraine newsroom programme page was opened at content level. It describes training, credits, roadmaps, and pilots, but does not clear the formal AI product-workflow or macro-structure threshold.

Direct OpenAI and text-mirror retrieval was partly blocked by 403 and SSL timeouts. Unresolved bodies remain candidate_only; no HTTP reachability or sitemap timestamp was treated as a no-match decision.
